name: Watercolor Storybook: Item Product Shot
description: Image preset for a item product shot in the Watercolor Storybook look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a prop or item shot. Describe material, wear, size cue, and the one detail that makes it recognisable from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: single item centred on a plain surface, three-quarter angle, whole object visible with its key detail facing the viewer, watercolour picture-book illustration, soft pencil line, loose washes that bleed past the line, visible paper texture, gentle rounded shapes, pastel palette, soft daylight, white paper showing through the highlights
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, harsh black outlines, neon colours, dark horror mood, text, watermark
